priorityList: Cast Halo on cooldown to trigger Archon benefits.
Use Power Infusion and offensive racial abilities while Voidform is active.
Enter Voidform once Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain are active on your targets.
Cast Void Volley whenever available during Voidform for high-priority burst AoE.
Cast Void Blast as your top priority during Archon windows (triggered by Halo).
Cast Shadow Word: Madness to maintain its damage-over-time effect and to prevent Insanity capping.
Use Tentacle Slam to apply or refresh Vampiric Touch, or if you are about to cap charges.
Cast Void Torrent when your dots (Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain/Madness) are active on targets.
Maintain Vampiric Touch on all targets (up to a maximum of 12) if they will live for at least 12 seconds.
Cast Mind Blast to generate Insanity, prioritizing procs like Mind Devourer.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity when available to spend procs.
Use Shadow Word: Death on targets below 20% health or while pets are active to trigger Inescapable Torment.
Use Shadow Word: Death as a movement or filler spell if the target is in execute range.
Channel Mind Flay as your filler when no higher priority abilities are available.
